description: Source code for a QR Code generator library, including class implementations for QR code encoding, drawing, masking, and error correction.

classes.name: QrCode
classes.description: Class representing a QR code, including methods for encoding data, drawing patterns, masking, and outputting SVG.

classes.name: QrSegment
classes.description: Class for QR code data segments, with methods to create segments from text or byte data and calculate total bits.

classes.name: BitBuffer
classes.description: Class for managing a buffer of bits, supporting appending bits and inserting data.

classes.name: ReedSolomonGenerator
classes.description: Class for generating Reed-Solomon error correction codewords used in QR code error correction.

methods.name: getFormatBits
methods.description: Returns format bits for a given error correction level.

methods.name: encodeText
methods.description: Encodes text into a QR code with specified error correction level and minimum version.

methods.name: encodeBinary
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a QR code with specified error correction level.

methods.name: encodeSegments
methods.description: Encodes multiple data segments into a QR code, choosing version and mask.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the QR code.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size (dimension) of the QR code.

methods.name: getErrorCorrectionLevel
methods.description: Returns the error correction level of the QR code.

methods.name: getMask
methods.description: Returns the mask pattern used in the QR code.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns whether a specific module (cell) in the QR code is black or white.

methods.name: toSvgString
methods.description: Outputs the QR code as an SVG string with specified border.

methods.name: drawFunctionPatterns
methods.description: Draws the function patterns (finder, alignment, timing) on the QR code.

methods.name: drawFormatBits
methods.description: Draws format information bits into the QR code.

methods.name: drawVersion
methods.description: Draws version information bits for versions 7 and above.

methods.name: drawFinderPattern
methods.description: Draws a finder pattern at specified coordinates.

methods.name: drawAlignmentPattern
methods.description: Draws an alignment pattern at specified coordinates.

methods.name: setFunctionModule
methods.description: Sets a module as part of the function patterns.

methods.name: module
methods.description: Checks if a module is black or white.

methods.name: appendErrorCorrection
methods.description: Calculates and appends error correction codewords to data.

methods.name: drawCodewords
methods.description: Places data codewords into the QR code modules.

methods.name: applyMask
methods.description: Applies a mask pattern to the QR code modules.

methods.name: handleConstructorMasking
methods.description: Selects the best mask pattern if not specified.

methods.name: getPenaltyScore
methods.description: Calculates the penalty score for a QR code based on masking rules.

methods.name: getAlignmentPatternPositions
methods.description: Returns positions for alignment patterns for a given version.

methods.name: getNumRawDataModules
methods.description: Returns total number of raw data modules for a version.

methods.name: getNumDataCodewords
methods.description: Returns number of data codewords for a version and error correction level.
